title: No MCP protocol server — homegrown dispatch class, no SDK/entrypoint
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/server.py:31 BrazilianSoccerMCP.handle_request dispatches dotted string methods (e.g. 'match.find') via an if/elif ladder; grep for 'import mcp|from mcp|jsonrpc|stdio|list_tools|call_tool|Server(' across all .py files returns zero hits; no console_scripts/pyproject entrypoint; the only __main__ is in tests/test_brazilian_soccer_mcp.py:391. README.md:39-45 documents usage as a plain Python library (server.handle_request('match.find', {...})).
suggestion: Use the MCP Python SDK (fastmcp / mcp.server): register each query as a @tool, expose an actual stdio/JSON-RPC transport, and add a __main__ entrypoint so the package runs as an MCP server rather than an in-process dispatch class.
